details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary HP healing does not repair it; destroyed at 0. Combat repair requires an explicit repair ability. Workshop repair remains a design question.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Pinprick tracks stop at every junction.

**Purpose:** Return an accurate account of a short route.

**Tactics and retreat:** Evade pursuit and use its needle only if cornered.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Cover the lens or recover the controller’s command token.

**Habitat:** Workshop; ruin · **Communication:** Reports simple spoken directions while active

**Loot:** Delicate parts worth 8 coins from a real destroyed scout; no summoned salvage.

**Summoning:** Construct 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/clockwork-scout.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-clockwork-scout


**Category:** Construct · **Role:** Surveyor · **CV:** 5

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its minor attack is easier to defend, granting a Boon.

**Reference damage:** 1/2/3

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.2

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.15 → 1.2: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=1.057. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [Roll Away](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/roll-away.md).

[Roster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/roster.md) · [Agreed Stability](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/rules/stability.md)

# Lifeless Body

*Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-lifeless-body


**Action:** Passive

The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

[Creature procedure](../bestiary/procedure.md) · [Monster ability index](README.md)
